The deterministic project-owned exporter is
`BlenderWork/Hands/export_axis_neutral_arms_unity.py`. It opens the source with

online updater, drivers, controllers and scripts are not runtime dependencies.

Generated FBX contract:

- Generic skeleton with deform bones retained;
- separate right/left side meshes generated by the Unity importer;
- `AxisArms_Drink` baked at 60 Hz for exactly `11.0 s`;
- approved drink-ready pose at `0.0 s` and exact return at `10.60 s`;
- four persistent finishing raises at approximately `2.20`, `4.20`, `6.20`
  and `8.20 s`;
- no animation events and no gameplay authority;
- right hand for drinking, smoking, wave and push; left hand for the
  middle-finger and thumbs-up gestures;
- real carried item follows a project-owned palm-local bottle grip anchor.

Sanitized generated FBX SHA-256:
`DC03305D8D63E59E28EDFC44F81906FAD047814DDE170DDA4BCE9CAC12E30D43`.
All fourteen project-authored clips are bone-only, event-free and sampled by a
project-owned runtime clock via `AnimationClip.SampleAnimation`. Unity 6 legacy
`Animation.Play` is deliberately not presentation authority for this Generic
hierarchy because executed PlayMode comparison reproduced catastrophic finger
stretching and camera-space translation only on that evaluation path.

Generated binaries and textures remain under the ignored private
`RuntimeBaseline`. Runtime item contents, use state, physics, needs and saves
remain project-owned and animation-independent.
